description: We are a six-member interdisciplinary team passionate about AI, software engineering, data science, and space research. For NASA Space Apps 2026, we are building an AI-powered platform to explore microgravity combustion experiments and transform scientific findings into accessible, evidence-backed fire safety insights. Our team combines full-stack development, AI/ML, data engineering, scientific research, UI/UX design, and testing. We aim to turn NASA's research into meaningful innovation.
